Believable detailed weathered teal blue shipping containers and one oxidized red container form strong perspective down a steel ship deck towards a white navigation bridge with dark glass windows, railings, antennas, life rings and distant blue ocean. Character occupies lower right third; clear sky and bridge in upper 40 percent reserved for later HTML title, dark steel deck lower 20 percent reserved for later button. Physically believable proportions, realistic high-end video game promotional 3D render, sunlight, ambient occlusion, steel panel seams, locks and corrugation, natural shadow depth, sophisticated restrained navy / sea blue / rust red / ivory palette. No logos, no text, no watermark, no HUD, no borders, no collage, no explosions, no gore. Vertical composition.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game material texture atlas, square 1024x1024, four equal square quadrants in an EXACT 2 by 2 grid, no borders or margins. Every quadrant is a front-on orthographic flat scan of a different realistic ship material, no perspective. TOP LEFT: off-white weathered ship paint, tiny gray scratches and subtle grime, matte metal. TOP RIGHT: faded desaturated navy teal painted steel, shallow narrow vertical corrugation, light chipped paint, subtle rust at edges. BOTTOM LEFT: oxidized red painted steel, shallow narrow vertical corrugation with slight chipped paint and subtle rusty streaks. BOTTOM RIGHT: medium blue-gray non-slip steel deck with small diagonal diamond tread pattern, subtle scuffs and wear. Neutral diffuse illumination, baked micro surface depth but no directional cast shadows, believable varied grain, game-ready albedo material sheet. No objects, no text, no labels, no letters, no watermark, no frame, no dramatic black damage. The four quadrants must each fill exactly one quarter of the image.
